But the cycle of loading in quarters and scurrying back to complete the various stages of car washing wastes wash time and is not optimal in general. I would prefer paying either via bills or best case scenario, via credit card. Aside from the quarters snag, everything is in order, all of the washing modes are available and the car wash is clean. text: Very expensive for a car wash
reply: Christy thanks for your review. Tom’s in Royersford? Our bays are the last ones in the country that start on one quarter, and our automatic is 2 -3 dollars under the average New touch -less auto. Our vacuums have been one dollar for the last 15 years… Unfortunately we had to raise our prices due to the outrageous costs from our new water/sewer company in the area. Who have tripled our costs. The touchless automatics use approximately 45 gallons of water per wash and a bit more chemicals then a typical express tunnel. We do pride ourselves in using the best presoaks, sealants, and waxes, and ceramics available. What other washes offer as a “$3-$4 buy up” or “add on” , we include in our top wash. All that said we do offer a great discount for fleet members. No minimum required.
